WOODWORK — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: WOODWORK
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Timber Defects, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Timber Defects.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Timber Defects.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Timber Defects.

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. International Cricket Team
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. Input Cable Tester

3. When learning Project activity, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Project activity.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Project activity.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Project activity.

4. When learning Mass Production, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Mass Production.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Mass Production.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Mass Production.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

5. When learning Portable Power Tools, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Portable Power Tools.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Portable Power Tools.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Portable Power Tools.

6. When learning Health and Safety in the Workshop, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and Safety in the Workshop.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Run with the tool
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Remove all guards

8. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

9. When learning Detailed drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Detailed drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Detailed drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Detailed drawing.

10. When learning Trends in woodwork, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Trends in woodwork.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Trends in woodwork.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Trends in woodwork.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

12. When learning Woodworking Machines, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Woodworking Machines.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Woodworking Machines.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Woodworking Machines.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Health and Safety in the Workshop and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Portable Power Tools and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Woodworking Machines and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Timber Defects and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Timber Defects.

2. C — Information and Communication Technology

3. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Project activity.

4. D — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Mass Production.

5. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Portable Power Tools.

6. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and Safety in the Workshop.

7. C — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

8. C — CPU

9. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Detailed drawing.

10. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Trends in woodwork.

11. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands

12. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Woodworking Machines.
